annotations.title: Base wallet balance: ETH and USDC

description: The ETH and USDC balance of any address on Base, read live from the chain, with the block it was read at. Use it when: An agent needs to know whether a Base wallet holds enough USDC or ETH, for example before paying or after a transfer. Not for: Other chains, other tokens, transaction history or moving funds. Returns: ETH and USDC balances as decimal strings, the USDC contract and the block number. Typical time: about 1 s. Price: $0.003 per lookup, charged only on success. One call = one wallet's ETH and USDC balance.

address.description: A Base (EVM) address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters
